d: Sharad Kapoor, the memorable 90s and early 2000s Bollywood actor known for his intense villainous role as the Bichhoo gang leader in the superhit film Josh opposite Shah Rukh Khan, once shared the screen in popular movies like Dastak with Sushmita Sen, LOC Kargil, Lakshya with Hrithik Roshan, and Jay Ho with Salman Khan. From his humble beginnings in Kolkata without any film family background to becoming a successful restaurant businessman and marrying Koel Basu, granddaughter of former West Bengal Chief Minister Jyoti Basu, his life took dramatic turns.
